description: System effects in T-shaped timber shear walls: effects of transverse walls, diaphragms, and axial loading under seismic loading: Supplementary Material is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Diego Valdivieso Cascante, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). This project explores the impact of transverse shear walls (TSW), diaphragm out-of-plane bending stiffness (FDIA), and axial loading (AXL) on the lateral dynamics of strong wood-frame shear walls (SWs) in multi-story light frame timber buildings (LFTBs) in highly seismic areas. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-bt1g-rm32. Keywords: System effects, non-planar shear walls, T-shaped wood-frame shear walls, transverse shear walls, out-of-plane stiffness, diaphragm. Published 2024-03-07. Facility named: Departamento de Ingeniería Estructural y Geotécnica, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
